body.message: All our properties are furnished, so unfortunately we don't have unfurnished 2BRs. That said, we do have two 2BRs near Business Bay, one in Elite Business Bay at AED 6,500/month and one in Urban Oasis at AED 8,500/month, both fully furnished and all-inclusive, paid month to month with the rate fixed for 3 months. Is the furnished part a dealbreaker, or would you want to take a look at either of those?
